title: Ownership (Part 3) - Mutable references
learning_objectives: Use `&mut` parameters to update owned data in place.
Distinguish read-only borrows from mutable borrows in function signatures.
Apply mutation through a reference without taking ownership of the value.
explanation: This slice builds on immutable borrowing by introducing mutable references. A helper can change a caller-owned value through `&mut` while the caller still keeps ownership of the `String` itself.

examples.title: Append text through `&mut String`
Mutate a collection through a borrowed reference

completion_criteria: Exercise tests pass while the original value is updated in place
Learner can explain why the function signature needs `&mut String` instead of `String`
